summary: First-run full stack test for Presensi Kredit (Expo + FastAPI + Mongo). Backend: 28/28 pytest tests passed covering auth (both roles, 401, 422 for short password), role gating (guru 403 on invoices/students POST/izin/class PUT), 8 seeded classes, class rename, student CRUD, wallets created per program, packages pricing (Rp 350k/900k gymnastic, Rp 495k/1.335k english), izin quotas (1 for 4-pack, 3 for 12-pack), invoice create/pay/delete, 409 duplicate unpaid, pay-twice 400, credits added + izin reset + makeup hangus on payment, attendance credit deduction with no double-deduct on re-save and refund on status change, pengganti requires makeup (400), dashboard + transactions. Frontend (mobile 390x844): login (both roles) works, logout works, home dashboard renders with role badge, tagihan tab correctly hidden for guru, navigation across tabs (beranda/presensi/siswa/tagihan) works, presensi class list -> class detail with date prev/next and attendance toggles, siswa list with search + add button, student detail with wallets + izin-open + create-invoice buttons, invoice form with student chips -> program -> package chips -> total text showing Rp 350.000 for Gymnastic 4-pack. No deprecated expo packages. No red-screen errors. Only console warning: shadow* style props deprecated (use boxShadow).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with boxShadow for future RN/Expo compatibility. Reference: likely in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts or component styles
